NO `dates`: the line gives «(IX до Р.Х.)», the ninth century before Christ, which would be this folder's first date of any kind and is a Roman numeral with an era attached; no reader of this wave has been told to write a first date off one, and a negative interval is a shape this corpus has not been shown to hold. The reading id946 was NOT opened. TWO HYMNS TAKEN where the folder had none of this calendar's, and A THIRD BLOCK WAS LEFT: the page prints «Величание» under his name, a magnification, and this corpus's `kind` vocabulary holds only troparion and kontakion — the same refusal made for `vladimir-the-great` on 15 июля. The troparion names Elisha, which is a hymn text and NOT a `related` row.

source.text: Calendarul zilei, Doxologia (doxologia.ro), 20 iulie — «Sfântul Slăvitul Proroc Ilie Tesviteanul»
saint.gr, το εορτολόγιο της 20ής Ιουλίου — «Προφήτης Ηλίας ο Θεσβίτης»

attestations.note: The life page heads «Τύπος εορτής: Σταθερή. Εορτάζει στις 20 Ιουλίου εκάστου έτους», the same day the folder's Romanian row already carries, and the man is the folder's own Tishbite: «ήταν γιος του Σωβάκ και καταγόταν από τη Θέσβη (γι' αυτό και ονομάστηκε Θεσβίτης), το σημερινό El Istib, της περιοχής Γαλαάδ». The Greek page gives the years the Romanian source did not and they are taken into `dates`. It also says he belonged to the tribe of Aaron, which the Romanian life does not, and it adds that eight or ten years after his ascent he sent a letter — perhaps by an angel — to king Joram foretelling his death, quoting 2 Chronicles 21:12. No asterisk and no «Δεν είναι διασταυρωμένη» sentence. The page prints six hymn texts and only two are taken: the Ἀπολυτίκιον and the Κοντάκιον, both of which name him. The two Μεγαλυνάρια, the Οἶκος and the Κάθισμα are left out because the schema holds a troparion or a kontakion and nothing else, not because there is anything wrong with them.

source.text: Православни подсетник (pravoslavno.rs), Охридски пролог за 02.08.2026 (20. јул ст. ст.) — „Св. пророк Илија.“

attestations.note: The day’s first entry, quoted whole with its closing full stop (§4). «Св.» is “saint” and no rank; «пророк» is the `prophet` this folder already carries, and `wonderworker` beside it is corroborated by the entry’s own opening word — „Боговидац, чудотворац, ревнитељ вере Божје, св. Илија би родом од племена Аронова из града Тесвита, због чега је прозват Тесвићанин.“, a seer of God, a wonderworker, a zealot for the faith of God — but a type already held is not written twice and those three words stand before the name rather than as a rank in it. **`dates` UNTOUCHED, AND THE BOOK IS SILENT RATHER THAN REFUSED.** The folder holds `floruit` -873 to -854 off saint.gr’s dating of the reign of Ahab. This entry names Ahab, Jezebel, Solomon and Jeroboam and gives NO YEAR AND NO CENTURY of any kind, so nothing is written, nothing widened and nothing narrowed. **A reign is not a date and this book offers only reigns.** **THE FOLD THIS FORM MAKES, AND IT IS FOUR WIDE BY THE END OF THE DAY.** `foldchk.py` measured «Илија» as already held in sr by `elias-martyr-with-patermuthius` and `elias-the-egyptian` — a pair the gate was printing as `?`, UNREAD, with no key at all — and `sr-foldpred.mjs` answered `new key, other holders: 2`. **The day’s second entry adds a fourth**, `elias-of-jerusalem`, off the same page, so the key written in this commit names all four and is read in the commit message. WHAT THE BOOK ADDS, AND THE FIRST THING IS HIS FATHER’S NAME IN A THIRD SPELLING. „Кад се Илија роди, отац његов Савах виде ангеле Божје око детета, како огњем дете повијају и пламен му дају да једе.“ — when Elijah was born his father Савах saw the angels of God about the child, swaddling him in fire and giving him flame to eat, „То би предзнамење Илијиног пламеног карактера и његове богодане силе огњене.“, a foretoken of his fiery character and of his God-given fiery power. **saint.gr, already in this folder’s prose, calls the father Sobak; this book calls him Савах; the two are left as the two books print them and neither is corrected into the other.** The tribe of Aaron and the town that gives him his by-name agree with the Greek page word for word. THE DIVIDED KINGDOM IS SET OUT AS NEITHER OTHER BOOK SETS IT OUT: „У то време царство јеврејско беше раздељено на два неједнака дела: царство Јудино обухватајући само два племена, Јудино и Венијаминово, са престоницом у Јерусалиму, и царство Израиљево обухватајући осталих 10 племена са престоницом у Самарији.“ — Judah holding two tribes with its capital at Jerusalem, Israel the other ten with its capital at Samaria — and „Првим царством владаху потомци Соломонови, а другим потомци Јеровоама, слуге Соломонова.“, the first ruled by Solomon’s descendants and the second by the descendants of Jeroboam, Solomon’s servant. AND JEZEBEL’S PART IS GIVEN A CAUSE: „При том још Језавеља као Сиријанка, наговори мужа те подиже храм Сиријскоме Богу Ваалу, и одреди многе свештенике на службу томе лажном богу.“, being a Syrian she talked her husband into raising a temple to the Syrian god Baal and appointed many priests to that false god’s service. THE WONDERS ARE ENUMERATED IN ONE SENTENCE OF EIGHTY-FOUR WORDS, and two of its clauses are figures neither other book gives: „он затвори небо, те не би кише три године и шест месеци;“, he shut up heaven so that there was no rain for THREE YEARS AND SIX MONTHS; and „прорече Ахаву, да ће му пси крв лизати, и Језавељи, да ће је пси изести, што се и догоди;“, he foretold to Ahab that the dogs would lick his blood and to Jezebel that the dogs would eat her, WHICH CAME TO PASS. „На Хориву разговараше с Богом и чу глас Божји у тихом светлом поветарцу.“, on Horeb he talked with God and heard the voice of God IN A QUIET BRIGHT BREEZE. „Пред смрт узе Јелисеја и одреди га за наследника у пророчком звању; својим огртачем пресече воду у Јордану: и најзад би узет на небо у огњеним колима са огњеним коњима.“ — before his death he took Elisha and appointed him his successor, cut the water of the Jordan with his own mantle, and was taken up in a fiery chariot with fiery horses. „На Тавору јавио се заједно с Мојсејем Господу нашем Исусу Христу.“, **on TABOR he appeared together with Moses to our Lord Jesus Christ** — where saint.gr says only «the mountain». And the entry closes on the end of the world: „Пред крај света опет ће се Илија јавити, да сузбије силу Антихристову (Откр. 11)“, Elijah will appear again to beat down the power of Antichrist, with the eleventh chapter of the Apocalypse cited for it. **The entry ends without a full stop, on the citation**, which is the page’s own and is not mended. NO NEW `related`, AND FOUR BIBLICAL NAMES THAT TAKE NONE. Elisha, Moses, Ahab, Jezebel, Solomon and Jeroboam are all named in the entry. `proseprobe.mjs` over the drafted paragraph returned **`0 name(s) the index would link`**, so not one of them is owed a row by `related-floor.test.mjs` — `elisha-the-prophet` and `moses-the-prophet` are folders of this corpus but their display names are not the bare forenames the prose uses, and this folder’s existing prose has named both of them unlinked since 24 September for the same reason. **Nothing was linked and nothing was added**: the kinship of Elijah to Elisha is worth a row and it is not this day’s to invent, the entry being the only thing read. Ahab, Jezebel, Solomon and Jeroboam hold no folders at all; `solomon-of-ephesus` is not the king, Ruling 3. The widow of Zarephath and her son hold none either. No `office`. No `locations`: Tesvit, Jerusalem, Samaria, Zarephath, Horeb, the Jordan and Tabor are all named and not one is written as a coordinate — seven place names in one entry and no `locations` object, which is the most this wave has refused in one row. The Prologue prints no troparion and no kontakion.

hymns.text: Cel ce a fost înger în trup, temeiul proorocilor, al doilea Înaintemergător al venirii lui Hristos, Ilie Măritul, care a trimis de sus lui Elisei dar, goneşte bolile şi pe cei leproşi curăţeşte. Pentru aceasta şi celor ce-l cinstesc pe dânsul le izvorăşte tămăduiri.

source.text: doxologia.ro, «Troparul Sfântului Slăvitul Proroc Ilie Tesviteanul», Glasul 4

english.text: You who were an angel in the flesh, the foundation of the prophets, the second Forerunner of the coming of Christ, glorious Elijah, who sent down grace from on high to Elisha: drive away sicknesses and cleanse the lepers. And so for those who honour him he pours out healings.

hymns.text: Ὁ ἔνσαρκος Ἄγγελος, τῶν Προφητῶν ἡ κρηπίς, ὁ δεύτερος Πρόδρομος, τῆς παρουσίας Χριστοῦ, Ἠλίας ὁ ἔνδοξος, ἄνωθεν καταπέμψας, Ἐλισαίῳ τὴν χάριν, νόσους ἀποδιώκει, καὶ λεπροὺς καθαρίζει, διὸ καὶ τοῖς τιμῶσιν αὐτόν, βρύει ἰάματα.

source.text: saint.gr, Ἀπολυτίκιον (Κατέβασμα), Ἦχος δ’, Ταχύ προκατάλαβε — the first of the six hymn texts on the page of «Προφήτης Ηλίας ο Θεσβίτης», and it names him

english.text: The angel in the flesh, the foundation of the prophets, the second forerunner of the coming of Christ, the glorious Elijah, who sent down his grace from above upon Elisha, drives away sicknesses and cleanses lepers; and so he pours out healings upon those who honour him.

hymns.text: Προφῆτα καὶ προόπτα τῶν μεγαλουργιῶν τοῦ Θεοῦ, Ἠλία μεγαλώνυμε, ὁ τῷ φθέγματί σου στήσας τὰ ὑδατόῤῥυτα νέφη, πρέσβευε ὑπὲρ ἡμῶν, πρὸς τὸν μόνον φιλάνθρωπον.

source.text: saint.gr, Κοντάκιον, Ἦχος β’, Αὐτόμελον — the second of the six hymn texts on the page of «Προφήτης Ηλίας ο Θεσβίτης», and it names him

english.text: Prophet and foreseer of the great works of God, Elijah of the great name, who by your word stayed the rain-pouring clouds, intercede for us before the only lover of mankind.

hymns.text: Во плоти Ангел,/ пророков основание,/ вторый Предтеча пришествия Христова, Илия славный,/ свыше пославый Елиссееви благодать/ недуги отгоняти/ и прокаженныя очищати,// темже и почитающим его точит исцеления.

source.text: Православный церковный календарь, Сретенский монастырь (days.pravoslavie.ru), 20 июля ст. ст. — «Тропарь пророка Илии», глас 4

english.text: An angel in the flesh, the foundation of the prophets, the second forerunner of the coming of Christ, glorious Elijah, who didst send down from above the grace to Elisha to drive away sicknesses and to cleanse lepers: therefore he pours out healings also upon those who honour him.

hymns.text: Пророче и провидче великих дел Бога нашего,/ Илие великоимените,/ вещанием твоим уставивый водоточныя облаки,// моли о нас Единаго Человеколюбца.

source.text: Православный церковный календарь, Сретенский монастырь (days.pravoslavie.ru), 20 июля ст. ст. — «Кондак пророка Илии», глас 2

english.text: O prophet and seer of the great works of our God, Elijah of great name, who by thy word didst stay the water-bearing clouds: pray for us to the only Lover of mankind.

floruit.note: saint.gr: «Ο Προφήτης Ηλίας άσκησε το προφητικό του χάρισμα επί 25 έτη στα χρόνια του βασιλέα Αχαάβ, που βασίλεψε στα 873 - 854 π.Χ.» The interval is that reign, which is the only one the page prints; it also sets him more broadly, «ο προφήτης Ηλίας έζησε τον 9 π.Χ. αιώνα». The twenty-five years of his prophesying are longer than the nineteen the reign allows, and the page does not reconcile them. The Romanian source the folder was built from gave no year for anything.
